title: Shopping starts with AI, so our store must be agent-ready
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% of US shoppers would use GenAI for gift ideas (Gartner). HP launched Experience AI; TikTok, Gap and Walmart added AI shopping. Omdia: PC shipments -21% in 3Q26.

points.headline: AI is now a mainstream path to purchase, and rivals are building for it
points.detail: NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery; HP launched Experience AI; TikTok and Gap added AI shopping. We should benchmark our search, content and checkout against these.

points.headline: PC demand is cooling just as memory costs squeeze AI PC pricing
points.detail: Omdia: global PC shipments fell 21% in 3Q26 as pull-forward demand faded; DigiTimes flags memory costs. We should plan holiday promotions and inventory for softer volume.

points.headline: Rivals push premium AI laptops through new price points and channels
points.detail: Microsoft priced Surface Laptop Ultra at $2,599 for on-device AI agents; Nvidia RTX Spark Windows laptops opened for pre-order. We should check our premium AI lineup pricing.

points.headline: Holiday spend is forecast at records, with AI and BNPL shaping carts
points.detail: Adobe forecasts $275.1B US online holiday sales (+6.7%); Amazon added BNPL in the UK; 47% of abandoners wanted a digital wallet. We should review payment options and gift-discovery content.
